messages.content: A tray has 7 rows of 6 bolts. Five bolts are removed. Explain the arithmetic briefly and give the final number.

message.content:
The tray initially has \(7 \text{ rows} \times 6 \text{ bolts per row} = 42 \text{ bolts}\). After removing 5 bolts, the remaining number is \(42 - 5 = 37\).

**Final Answer:** \boxed{37}
